activity_summary: You ate three bites and drank small beer before Errors. The penny loaf is still a finger short, measured on Friday and not measured again. Board is threepence. You told Alse the old man is nearly hanged and then is not. You said you are not ill. Gillis had already eaten and gone to the loom. The cat was on the book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate little, answered the rope, and said he was not ill.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Named the finger, the threepence, and the stair.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked about the hanging and the boys, and took the plates.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Named as already gone to the loom. Not in the room.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in Three bites, and a finger

entities.name: Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Three bites, and a finger

facets.activity: Ate three bites of the finger-short loaf

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A penny loaf, a finger short, the same as Friday.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not hungry before a play, Mistress.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am empty before a play. I am not ill.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: Is the man in your play hanged, sir?
